summary: tri-Ace and Square Enix's Xbox 360 action RPG, now playable on modern Xbox hardware through backward compatibility.

entries.title: Infinite Undiscovery

emulation.notes: Prefer official Xbox backward compatibility over unofficial Xbox 360 emulation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Xbox backward-compatible output on Series X/S.

primary.why: Infinite Undiscovery was released for Xbox 360 and is sold/playable on Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S; modern Xbox hardware is the cleanest official high-fidelity capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy the Xbox store version or use an owned disc on a compatible Xbox One or Xbox Series X/S. Capture from modern HDMI output.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake/remaster exists; this is a backward-compatible Xbox 360 title.
